units.source_text: 他像是要摇醒睡梦中的孩子似的。

en.t: He seemed as if he were trying to shake awake a sleeping child.

units.source_text: 名人好容易才听见，嘴里还念念叨叨的，但声音嘶哑，吐不出来，听不清他说些什么。

en.t: The Master only just managed to hear, and he was still muttering under his breath, but his voice was hoarse and would not come out, so it was impossible to make out what he was saying.

units.source_text: 多半是知道到封盘时间了吧。

en.t: Most likely he realized that it was time to seal the move.

units.source_text: 日本棋院八幡干事把准备好的信封拿来，名人却好像对待旁人的事，呆呆地审视了好一阵子。

en.t: Director Yahata of the Nihon Ki-in brought over the prepared envelope, but the Master stared at it blankly for quite some time, as though it concerned someone else.

units.source_text: 然后他又带着不能立即回到现实中来的表情说：

en.t: Then, with an expression as if he could not immediately return to reality, he said:
